title: Input rewind at the left boundary
statement: Let $E$ and $G$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and suppose $E$ has at least one work tape. Choose states $e_0,e_f$ of $E$ and $g_0,g_f$ of $G$, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Starting from the loop-body machine's configuration in its input-rewind state, with the input head at the left boundary, $x$ stored on work tape $0$, every other work tape blank, all work-tape heads at cell $0$, and the output empty, one step yields the configuration in the anchor state with the input head at the first input cell, the same tape contents, all work-tape heads at cell $0$, and the output empty.
